## About

The AI Coding Agents Workshop is a public, hands-on curriculum for researchers who want to use coding agents while retaining scientific judgment, clear project structure, and reproducible Git practices.

## Who it is for

The material supports workshop participants, research students, instructors, and research-software teams. It includes a slide deck, local setup guides, prompt patterns, reproducibility notes, demonstrations, exercises, and a reusable project template.

## What it provides

- A guided path from setup to independent exercises
- Three geoscience-oriented exercises with explicit inputs and outputs
- Templates for small research coding projects
- Practical guidance for reviewing agent-generated work
